item.sculktitan.titan_syringe.tooltip: Inject to become a Sculk Titan for 10 minutes.
item.sculktitan.titan_syringe.tooltip2: Afterwards you gain the power and can transform with a key.
message.sculktitan.awakened: The Titan power has awakened! Transform with the key now.
message.sculktitan.locked: You have not gained the Titan power yet. Use the syringe.
message.sculktitan.cooldown: Wait a moment before transforming again.
message.sculktitan.already: You already have the Titan power, the syringe is no longer needed.
gui.sculktitan.footer: Click or press 1-3 to select, Esc to close
gui.sculktitan.berserk_active: BERSERK PHASE: %s s - cooldowns twice as fast, abilities stronger
ability.sculktitan.shriek.name: Abyssal Resonance
ability.sculktitan.shriek.desc: The Titan lets out a deafening shriek: a shockwave spreads 16 blocks. Damages, knocks back and blinds enemies with darkness.
ability.sculktitan.spikes.name: Sculk Spikes
ability.sculktitan.spikes.desc: A fan of sculk tendrils erupts from the ground ahead for 18 blocks. Damages, launches and roots enemies.
ability.sculktitan.drain.name: Soul Devour
ability.sculktitan.drain.desc: Five pulses drain the life from everything within 14 blocks, slow it down and heal the Titan.
ability.sculktitan.sense.name: Vibration Sense
ability.sculktitan.sense.desc: You feel sculk vibrations: every creature within 20 blocks glows for 8 seconds.
ability.sculktitan.dash.name: Sculk Dash
ability.sculktitan.dash.desc: A short dash forward on a wave of sculk. Weak, but helps to flee or close the distance.
ability.sculktitan.grip.name: Sculk Grip
ability.sculktitan.grip.desc: Sculk clings to the creature you look at (up to 10 blocks): a little damage, slowness and weakness.
message.sculktitan.no_target: No target in front of you.
message.sculktitan.berserk_lock: You cannot turn back while berserk!
message.sculktitan.berserk.title: BERSERK PHASE
message.sculktitan.berserk.subtitle: Sculk feeds on pain - the Titan is enraged
message.sculktitan.berserk.end: The rage fades. The Titan is exhausted.
item.sculktitan.titan_syringe.tooltip3: Titan power lets you eat sculk (healing) and use sculk abilities.
